facts.content: Assessment is probable viral upper respiratory tract infection or early influenza.

facts.content: Night sweats are considered a constitutional symptom of viral illness to be monitored.

facts.content: Differential diagnoses include early influenza, COVID-19, bacterial pharyngitis, and allergic rhinitis.
